text: The Applicant for 18 Sandfield Road has requested North York Community Council to exempt their property from the following by-law requirements: City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 - 1.3 Swimming pool enclosures. - Section C. Access Protection (3) - Section C. Access Protection (6)(c)(1) - Section E. Construction standards (1)(b) - Section E. Construction standards (2) (c) [1] The Applicant for 18 Sandfield Road is requesting an exemption for their existing fence as constructed. - The swimming pool enclosure constructed with vertical metal pickets has spaces between in excess of 38mm apart (99mm measured) where horizontal rails are spaced less than 1.2 meters apart. (Section E. (2) (c) [1]) - The swimming pool enclosure is less than 1.8 meters high, and is closer than 1 meter to an external condition (iron hand rail), which can facilitate climbing the outside of the enclosure…
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item to the first regular meeting of North York Community Council in the 2026-2030 term of City Council.
